models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Ten days out - nothing but light NE-to-NW air and sub-3 ft seas in range; the trip dates themselves are still unforecastable.
briefing.synopsis: The current pattern over the Aeolians is slack: ECMWF IFS 0.25° (23 Sep 06Z) and ICON-2i (23 Sep 12Z) agree on an easterly to northeasterly flow today of 6-12 kt at the outer islands (Panarea 12.4 kt at midnight, 8.4 kt by midday), backing through north overnight and collapsing to 1-4 kt across the group on 24 Sep. By 25 Sep the flow reorganises into a light westerly, 6-8 kt at Filicudi and Salina, before easing again by evening. Seas fall with it - MFWAM (23 Sep 00Z) and ECMWF WAM (06Z) take total wave height from 2.8 ft at Filicudi this morning down to 0.3-0.8 ft by 25 Sep. The model data ends at 23:00 on 29 Sep, five days short of the 4 Oct departure, so none of this is a forecast for the trip.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight, 23 Sep, the fleet is at Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and with only 4.5 kt from the north at 18:00 (IFS 06Z) the berth choice does not matter. Wave and swell at Portorosa are 1.4 ft and easing to 1.0 ft by midnight. Nothing in the payload would push anyone to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: 24 Sep looks near-calm: 2-5 kt at Portorosa, 0.7 kt at Filicudi at 06:00, seas 0.6-0.8 ft (IFS 0.25°, 23 Sep 06Z). Any departure window you like, on motor more than sail. Treat this only as a check on the analysis - the real first leg is 4 Oct.

passage_notes.leg: Portorosa → Lipari (rehearsal 24 Sep; real date 4 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Dry run scores go, 4.8 kt beam reach, 06:00 start. Not a forecast for 4 Oct.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Panarea (rehearsal 25 Sep; real date 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 8.4 kt broad reach, flagged as deteriorating after 11:00.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Stromboli, optional (rehearsal 26 Sep; real 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 8.8 kt head to wind - a motoring leg in this pattern.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional (rehearsal 27 Sep; real 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 10.4 kt run, with gusts to 29 kt noted in the rehearsal scoring.
Go, 2.9 kt broad reach - essentially windless.
Go, 3.0 kt close reach; 9 kt gust against a 3 kt mean is a single-model artifact, not a caution.

cautions: The gust figures in light air are interval maxima, not sustained values - Panarea shows 45.3 kt gust against a 6.6 kt mean at midday 25 Sep, Salina 42.0 kt against 7.9 kt, Filicudi 36.2 kt against 7.6 kt. Read these as model noise in slack flow, but note the Aeolian channels do accelerate.

Models disagree by more than 6 kt at several hours: Lipari 06:00 today 3.1-10.5 kt, Filicudi midday 25 Sep 4.5-10.9 kt, Salina 18:00 25 Sep 1.2-7.6 kt, Lipari 18:00 25 Sep 0.4-8.7 kt. Quote the range, not a single number.
The rehearsal berth at Stromboli (Marina del Gabbiano) scores only 'workable' - open from every direction, with 12 kt of NE blowing straight in. Shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm.
ICON-2i runs only ~60-72 h ahead and AIFS publishes no gust field, so beyond three days you are on IFS and the wave models alone.
briefing.confidence_note: Confidence is high for the next 48 h - stability checks show mean wind shifts of 0.5-0.6 kt at 0-24 h lead - but the departure date is five days past where any model in this payload reaches, and at 72-120 h lead the mean direction shift is already 51 degrees.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
